title: Spec Feature Manifest Schema
description: A complete, structured enumeration of the features a format's real specification defines, produced by enumerate_spec_features.py. This is the artifact that Gate 9 (Product Mapping Complete) requires before implementation_authorized may be set true in registry/format-registry.yaml — see docs/gates.md and .claude/commands/enumerate-spec-features.md. Distinct from the bootstrap FACT-<FMT>-NNN structural facts produced by sal_master_runner.py: those cover only the format's core shape (2-3 facts, typical across the whole 26-format portfolio); this manifest is meant to cover the full breadth of the specification (document/message types, encodings, elements, fields, safety/validation rules, and API capabilities a genuinely usable library must expose).

generator.description: Tool name and version that validated/wrote this manifest.

authored_by.description: Identity of the agent/process that performed the spec reading (enumeration is comprehension-driven; this tool validates and canonicalizes the result, it does not itself read the spec).

feature_id.description: Extends the FACT-<FMT>-NNN convention. Uses the 100+ range to distinguish deep feature-manifest entries from the 001-099 bootstrap structural facts.

requirement_level.description: mandatory = a real-world file/consumer of this feature would consider the library broken without it. recommended = commonly needed, not universally required. optional = long-tail/rare.

spec_citation.description: Section/page/URL fragment in the real spec this feature comes from.

evidence_keywords.description: Function names, class names, property names, or literal strings that compute_feature_coverage.py's static scanner searches for as evidence this feature is implemented in src/python/<format_id>/. Authored by whoever did the spec-vs-code comparison, since they already identified the exact evidence location.
